argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_billing_id: 5fd58bf2-961e-40f0-bbb9-c2955df160ae. Basis: the swing rebill rule 'A swing excess correction is worked on the agreement's most recently posted swing_excess_charge line' and the base rule 'returned as one rebill_credit tied to that line through source_billing_id'; find_bizgas_billing returns this line (cycle 2026-01-01, posted 2026-02-09) as the latest swing_excess_charge line. Uniqueness: the other swing excess lines (Dec 2022, Jan 2023, Dec 2023, Jan 2024, Jan 2025) are older and outside the twelve-month lookback; energy lines are not swing excess lines.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.billing_period_start: 2026-01-01. Basis: the docstring 'the first day of the billing cycle of the corrected line, written YYYY-MM-DD exactly as it appears on that line' and the base event field 'billing_period_start: Billing cycle of the corrected line'; the January 2026 swing excess line carries billing_period_start 2026-01-01. argument_uniqueness_tracing.rebill_amount_usd: 243.30. Factors: monthly contract volume round(40800/12)=3400; swing tolerance 20+10=30 (46 energy lines on file >= 36, one excess line in twelve months) so upper end 4420; cycle usage 4080+370=4450, measured excess 30, no more than 10% of 3400 so halved to 15 therms; adder 0.0200 because the Business Fixed 36 electricity agreement on the same premise is active on a fixed term; price 0.6150 (January 2026 index notice) + 0.0200 = 0.6350; correct amount 9.53; over-billed 242.35-9.53 = 232.82; one rebill credit in 24 months gives 0.0050 per month; the January index notice was dated 2026-01-06 after the cycle began and went by mail, so 9 months from 2026-01-01; interest round(232.82 x 0.005 x 9,2)=10.48; credit 243.30, within the 250.00 agent limit.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.loyalty_credit_usd: 282.50. Factors: base credit = renewal_loyalty_credit_usd of Fixed 24 = 75.00; one renewal_loyalty_credit already on the agreement (2024-10-18) so x2 = 150.00; 46 energy lines on file so the spend is half the 24-month posted sum after the swing rebill = 59793.28/2 = 29896.64, which is at least 15000 and below 30000, multiplier 1.25 -> 187.50; tenure 47 whole months since 2022-11-01 (24 to 47) -> +20; electricity agreement on the premise active with 11 electricity energy lines in the last twelve months (>= 10) -> +50; 26 days before 2026-10-31 (>= 21) -> +25; total 282.50.

user_scenario: You are Teresa Sandoval, owner of Sandoval Linen Services LLC, a commercial laundry in Columbus, Ohio. You are calling Beacon Ridge Energy from the plant floor between loads, friendly but short on time, and you talk the way a small-business owner does: plain, a little impatient with jargon. The reason for your call: two letters came about the gas contract at the laundry plant at 1840 Fields Ave, saying the current fixed price ends on October 31, and you want to renew it now, before it runs out, on the offer in the letters. You noticed the second letter, the one from late September, quoted a slightly lower price than the August one, and you want whatever the latest offer is - the 24-month fixed plan. You do not want to end up on a floating monthly price. When the agent asks who you are, you give the business phone number 6145550163; if asked to confirm your identity you also give the last four digits of the company EIN, 4417. You do not remember the customer number or the date the account was opened, and you say so if asked. If the agent asks which site, it is the laundry plant at 1840 Fields Ave; the company has no other gas site with Beacon Ridge. If asked, you confirm that the plant also gets its electricity from Beacon Ridge. You have no idea how any of the contract figures are worked out and you do not try to guess. If the agent points out a charge on the gas account that was billed too high and needs putting right, you ask them to correct it, and you do not question the figure. You are the authorized person for the business and you want to accept the renewal yourself: once the agent says the renewal is ready and hands it to you to accept, you accept it with exactly the details the agent reads out to you, and you repeat back what the confirmation says if the agent asks. If the agent quotes a renewal price or plan that is not the one from the latest letter, you say that does not match the September letter and ask them to check it again, without offering a number of your own. Once the agent tells you the renewal is recorded, you thank them and end the call; you do not ask for anything else.

factor_trace: swing_band_tolerance (parameter): 46 energy_charge lines on file (Nov 2022 - Aug 2026) and exactly one swing_excess_charge line with billing_period_start in the last twelve months (the January 2026 line; the January 2025 line starts 20 months back) -> tier 1, swing_tolerance_pct 20 + tol_bonus_established_pct 10 = 30 -> upper end round(3400 x 1.30) = 4420; baseline tolerance 20 gives upper end 4080, measured excess 370 in the moderate relief tier (370 x 0.75 = 277.5, rounded up to 278 therms) and a result of 68.78.

excess_bundle_adder (parameter, cross_difficulty bizpower): the Business Fixed 36 agreement on the same premise is active with term_months 36 -> tier 1, adder bundle_adder_fixed 0.0200; baseline adder 0.0400 gives 242.98.

excursion_relief (method): cycle usage 4080 + 370 = 4450, measured excess 4450 - 4420 = 30, which is no more than 10% of the 3400-therm monthly contract volume -> halved and rounded down = 15 therms; baseline counts 30 therms as measured and gives 233.35.

repeat_overcharge_interest_rate (parameter): rebill credits posted in the last 24 months = 1 (2025-03-20, -35.10; the 2024-09-10 credit is 24 months back and outside) -> tier 2, 0.0050 per month; baseline no interest gives 232.82.

interest_anchor (method): the January 2026 monthly_index_price notice is dated 2026-01-06, after billing_period_start 2026-01-01, and went by mail -> months counted from 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-05 = 9; baseline anchors on posted_date 2026-02-09 = 7 months and gives 240.97.

plumbing: excess line amount 242.35 (370 therms at 0.6550), January 2026 index 0.6150, monthly contract volume round(40800/12) = 3400, correct excess amount round(15 x 0.6350, 2) = 9.53, over-billed 242.35 - 9.53 = 232.82, interest round(232.82 x 0.005 x 9, 2) = 10.48, result 232.82 + 10.48 = 243.30.

factor_trace: renewal_history_carry (method): one renewal_loyalty_credit line already on the agreement (-75.00 posted 2024-10-18) -> base credit 75.00 (Fixed 24 renewal_loyalty_credit_usd) x 2 = 150.00; baseline carries 75.00 and gives 188.75.

credit_spend_window (method): 46 energy lines on file >= 24 -> half the 24-month posted sum; after the swing rebill the 24-month sum is 59793.28, half = 29896.64; baseline (12-month sum 30593.42) would give multiplier 1.5 and 320.00.
credit_spend_multiplier (parameter): 29896.64 is at or above 15000 and below 30000 -> spend_mult_mid 1.25; baseline multiplier 1 gives 245.00.
supply_tenure_bonus (parameter): service_start_date 2022-11-01 to 2026-10-05 = 47 whole months (near-miss: not yet 48) -> tenure_bonus_mid_usd 20; baseline 0 gives 262.50.

electricity_bundle_bonus (parameter, cross_difficulty bizpower): electricity agreement on the premise active and 11 electricity energy lines with billing_period_start in the last twelve months (Nov 2025 - Sep 2026; the Oct 2025 line is exactly twelve months back and excluded) -> bundle_bonus_full_usd 50; baseline 0 gives 232.50.
early_acceptance_bonus (parameter): 26 calendar days from 2026-10-05 to contract_end_date 2026-10-31 -> early_bonus_usd 25; baseline 0 gives 257.50.

plumbing: result = round(150.00 x 1.25 + 20 + 50 + 25, 2) = 282.50; the prerequisite (swing rebill posted) is a value input through spend_24m: without it the measure is 30018.29 and the credit 320.00.

edges.condition: The most recently posted swing_excess_charge line of the agreement, when its billed amount_usd exceeds the correct swing excess amount and its posted_date is no more than billing_dispute_lookback_months calendar months before the handling date, has a rebill_credit line in bizgas_billing whose source_billing_id points at it, so the spend sums read the agreement's net billed charges.
edges.policy_source: The renewal loyalty credit is fixed only after the agreement's most recently posted swing excess line, when its billed amount is above the correct swing excess amount and its correction lookback has not ended, carries its own rebill credit.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The January 2026 swing excess line was billed at 242.35 (370 therms at 0.6550) while the swing rules give 9.53 (15 therms at 0.6350), and no rebill_credit line in the ledger has source_billing_id pointing at it; the only rebill credits correct the August 2024 and February 2025 energy lines.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The swing rebill write adds one rebill_credit line of -243.30 with source_billing_id = the January 2026 swing excess line; spend_24m falls from 60036.58 to 59793.28 and the spend measure from 30018.29 to 29896.64.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge, a chain of two problems: the renewal loyalty credit sums the posted ledger, so it must be evaluated after the rebill credit lands; the reverse order would book the credit at 320.00 instead of 282.50 and is excluded by the prerequisite sentence. No parallel prerequisites exist.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the rebill: the rebill_credit line is missing from the terminal ledger and loyalty_credit_usd becomes 320.00 instead of 282.50 (spend measure 30018.29 crosses spend_high_usd, multiplier 1.5 instead of 1.25).

design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (commercial_gas_care, category bizgas).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 5]}. Root bizgas_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit takes 6 factors, prerequisite bizgas_ext_swing_excess_rebill takes 5. Task 1 draw (--tasks 2): 1 prerequisite, [5, 5].
[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed here: bizgas_ext_swing_excess_rebill (bizgas_adjustment on a swing_excess_charge line, tool post_bizgas_swing_rebill_d99acf60, owner agent) and bizgas_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit (bizgas_renew + bizgas_credit for an acceptance on or before contract_end_date, tool accept_bizgas_renewal_offer_c0a82e44, owner user). Left for task 1: a renewal accepted after the agreement has rolled to the monthly index (bizgas_renew after rollover, a separate user write whose new term starts on the acceptance date and which earns no loyalty credit), and the correction of energy_charge lines billed after a rollover (bizgas_adjustment on energy lines) - an independent tree with its own user write and its own value_input edge. The only user-owned numeric event in this product is bizgas_renew (withdrawal and cancellation carry no computed quantity), so the two tasks split renewals by stage: before expiry here, after rollover in task 1.
[Why a good test] The surface ask is 'renew my gas contract on the latest letter'. The scored loyalty credit is never named by the customer; it is booked by her own acceptance and its policy says it is fixed only after every swing excess line billed above the swing rules carries its rebill credit. The agent must (1) read that prerequisite sentence, (2) audit the ledger and find that the January 2026 swing excess line (5fd58bf2-961e-40f0-bbb9-c2955df160ae) was billed 242.35 while the extended swing rules give 9.53, (3) compute and post that rebill (5 factors, interest included), (4) recompute the spend on the post-rebill ledger and build the credit (6 factors, two reading the business electricity product), (5) hand the acceptance to the customer with the governing offer copied from the final options notice. Difficulty comes from policy reading, ledger reconciliation (46 energy cycles, 24-month posted sums, rebill history, price notices) and cross-category reads, not from tool choice.
[Problem-tree card] Root bizgas_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit -> prerequisite bizgas_ext_swing_excess_rebill, kind value_input, gate spend_24m, form state. Prerequisite sentence (in the root's own rule): 'The renewal loyalty credit is fixed only after the agreement's most recently posted swing excess line, when its billed amount is above the correct swing excess amount and its correction lookback has not ended, carries its own rebill credit.' Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; the waited-on side is a record-visible state (a rebill credit standing against the agreement's most recently posted swing excess line when it is above the correct swing excess amount and inside its lookback); no tool, policy id or code token; strength 'only after' over exactly that one line. Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: the swing excess rebill (task 1's shortfall rebill posts credits on swing shortfall lines only). Derivation: sentence + ledger (swing excess line 5fd58bf2-961e-40f0-bbb9-c2955df160ae, no rebill credit with that source_billing_id) + the swing rebill rule ('returned as one rebill_credit tied to the line through source_billing_id') -> post the swing rebill on 5fd58bf2-961e-40f0-bbb9-c2955df160ae. Opening falsity: initial_state.bizgas_billing.5fd58bf2-961e-40f0-bbb9-c2955df160ae.amount_usd = 242.35 vs 9.53 allowed; the two existing rebill credits point at the Aug 2024 and Feb 2025 energy lines. Resolving owner: agent. Topological order: swing rebill (step 9) then renewal acceptance (step 11). Deletion sensitivity (Step 5 run): skipping the rebill leaves spend measure 30018.29 (>= 30000) and the credit becomes 320.00 instead of 282.50, and the terminal ledger lacks the -243.30 line. The persona never mentions the swing line or any correction (passive consent only). Tools validate nothing: both bodies write unconditionally.
[Base-invariant card] Step 9 (bizgas_adjustment): bizgas_billing_correction.bizgas_dispute_lookback - anchor bizgas_billing.posted_date of 5fd58bf2-961e-40f0-bbb9-c2955df160ae = 2026-02-09, 12 calendar months, lookback ends 2027-02-09 inclusive, frozen 2026-10-05 inside; bizgas_one_correction_per_line - no rebill_credit in initial_state has source_billing_id 5fd58bf2-961e-40f0-bbb9-c2955df160ae. Agent limit 250.00: 243.30 is within it, so a rebill credit (not a dispute) is posted. Step 11 (bizgas_renew/bizgas_credit): bizgas_renewal.bizgas_renewal_active - status active; bizgas_post_expiry_grace - the agreement has not rolled over (contract_end_date 2026-10-31 > frozen date), so the acceptance is pre-expiry and the gate does not bite; just-before/at-boundary cases are in temporal_feasibility. Other base rules inherited unchanged: offered plan and price from the governing (final options) notice, contract_annual_therms = premise annual_therm_usage (44774), new term starts the day after contract_end_date (2026-11-01), end date by the base end-date rule (2028-10-31).
[Business-object card] Swing rebill object: the January 2026 swing excess line 5fd58bf2-961e-40f0-bbb9-c2955df160ae (cycle 2026-01-01..2026-01-31) read with the energy line of the same cycle (bd6e2f99-8a44-4a2f-8a6c-9553740fd02d, 4080 therms). Excluded: older excess lines (Dec 2022, Jan 2023, Dec 2023, Jan 2024, Jan 2025) are outside the lookback; energy lines are under-billed by the wider band and under-billing is not back-billed. Loyalty credit object: agreement 9219a08a-ed1c-4c9d-a125-962d47f1fc7c; spend sums read every line of this agreement only.
[Factor card - swing rebill, 5 factors] swing_band_tolerance (parameter, multi-source: energy lines on file x excess lines in 12 months) tier 1 -> tolerance 30, baseline 20 gives 68.78 (moderate relief tier, 277.5 rounded up to 278); excess_bundle_adder (parameter, cross_difficulty bizpower: status x term_months of the electricity agreement on the premise) tier 1 -> 0.0200, baseline 0.0400 gives 242.98; excursion_relief (method) measured 30 <= 340 -> halved to 15, baseline as measured gives 233.35; repeat_overcharge_interest_rate (parameter) one rebill in 24 months -> 0.0050/month, baseline none gives 232.82 (near-miss: the 2024-09-10 rebill is before the 24-month boundary 2024-10-05 and excluded); interest_anchor (method; date and channel of one notice row, not counted as multi-source) January notice dated 2026-01-06 by mail -> 9 months from cycle start, baseline 7 months from posting gives 240.97. Whole baseline: 0.00 (base swing rules find no over-billing).
[Factor card - loyalty credit, 6 factors] renewal_history_carry (method) prior loyalty credit on file -> x2, baseline 188.75; credit_spend_window (method) 46 energy lines -> half the 24-month sum 29896.64, baseline 12-month sum 30593.42 gives 320.00; credit_spend_multiplier (parameter) 1.25, baseline 1 gives 245.00; supply_tenure_bonus (parameter) 47 months -> 20 (near-miss: counted from the enrollment date 2022-09-14 it would be 48 months; the rule counts from service_start_date), baseline 262.50; electricity_bundle_bonus (parameter, cross_difficulty bizpower, multi-source: status x 11 electricity energy lines in 12 months; the Oct 2025 line starts 2025-10-01, before the 12-month boundary 2025-10-05, and is excluded) -> 50, baseline 232.50; early_acceptance_bonus (parameter) 26 days -> 25, baseline 257.50. Whole baseline 75.00. No stamp field names any tier; every tier rests on ledger rows, dates or the electricity records.
[Seed rows] customers/premises: identity and the site (annual_therm_usage 44774 = sum of the last twelve billed cycles). bizgas_agreements: the active Fixed 24 agreement renewed once in 2024. bizgas_billing: 46 energy lines, 6 swing excess lines, 15 service fee lines (Nov 2022 - Jan 2024, before the electricity agreement started 2024-02-01 and the dual-commodity waiver applied), 2 rebill credits on mis-keyed energy lines, the 2024 loyalty credit. bizgas_notices: 46 monthly index notices and four expiration notices (2024 and 2026 pairs). bizpower_agreements/bizpower_billing: the Business Fixed 36 agreement on the same premise and 12 energy lines (Oct 2025 - Sep 2026). Every row is read by a gold finder (replay closure 136/136). No automatic clause fires: the gas term ends 2026-10-31 after the frozen date, the electricity term runs to 2027-01-31, no cancellation is pending.
[Persona] Teresa Sandoval, busy laundry owner, plain speech. Volunteers: renew the Fields Ave contract before it ends, on the latest letter, 24-month fixed. On request: phone 6145550163, EIN last four 4417, site address, that the plant also has Beacon Ridge electricity. Passive: when the agent points out a charge billed too high she asks for it to be corrected (that request is her dispute of the line); accepts the renewal herself with the details read out; challenges a plan or price that does not match the September letter without naming a number; closes when told the renewal is recorded. No extra ask.
[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, 4417) -> premises -> gas agreement -> gas notices -> gas billing -> electricity agreement -> electricity billing -> unlock+call swing rebill (5fd58bf2-961e-40f0-bbb9-c2955df160ae, 2026-01-01, 243.30) -> unlock (agent) + call (user) renewal acceptance (Fixed 24, 24, 0.7420, 44774, 2026-11-01, 2028-10-31, 282.50).
[Verification] _authoring evaluator built on check_compute.build_env/eval_compute: swing rebill on the opening world = 243.30 (factor baselines 68.78 / 242.98 / 233.35 / 232.82 / 240.97, all-baseline 0.00); loyalty credit on the opening world 320.00 (spend 30018.29), on the world after the rebill 282.50 (spend 29896.64; factor baselines 188.75 / 320.00 / 245.00 / 262.50 / 232.50 / 257.50; all-baseline 75.00). Gates run per task: check_extended, check_task_tools, replay_tasks (12 actions, det True, closure 136 = init 136), check_solvability, check_compute (2 comps, 11 factors, 2 cross factors), check_grounding, check_cross_fire all OK; check_traceability deferred until the KB is published.
[Revisions] (1) Symptom: replay flagged 12 dangling bizpower_billing.premise_id='' -> root cause: empty FK string counted as a reference -> change: omit premise_id on electricity energy lines (the schema leaves it empty on non-fee lines) -> replay OK. (2) Symptom: spend thresholds did not separate the 12- and 24-month measures -> change: year-one usage reflects an added dryer line (x1.11, capped at the band) and the January 2025 cold month 4400 therms -> 24-month half crosses 30000 only before the rebill, 12-month sum stays above it.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] Using only the policy prose, the finders and the persona: the renewal rule's prerequisite sentence sends the agent to the swing excess lines; the latest one (Jan 2026) recomputed with the swing rebill ladders gives 243.30; the loyalty credit rule on the post-rebill ledger gives 282.50; offered plan/price come from the final options notice (governing). Same as gold.
[Rework round 2 - policy-task audit] F-G1: both prerequisite sentences now wait on the agreement's most recently posted swing excess (shortfall) line, when it is above the correct swing excess (shortfall) amount and inside its correction lookback, carrying its own rebill credit; older lines (e.g. the January 2025 excess line, posted 2025-02-09, lookback ended 2026-02-09) are outside the sentence, so the gate is satisfiable by exactly the one write, and 'correct swing excess amount' names the charter's quantity, excluding a reading by the superseded base band. Edge condition updated verbatim from the policy. F-G4: the moderate relief tier now rounds up in compute (int(x) + 1 when x has a fraction), matching the rule; swing_band_tolerance factor_sensitivity re-run: 68.78 (was 69.44); gold unaffected (minor tier). F-G2: renewal_history_carry relabelled effect parameter (values x2 / x0.5 / x1); the credit keeps one method factor (credit_spend_window). O-G1: the loyalty rule now states that an on-time acceptance takes the plan, term and price of the final_options_notice where the two notices differ (here 0.7420). O-G3: bizgas_agg_portfolio_bandwidth added to the excess rule's lineage with a scope sentence (only portfolio-plan agreement of the business, as here). O-G4: both rebill rules state that a business asking for a pointed-out line to be put right is disputing it; the persona now asks for the correction. O-G8: excursion_relief binds measured_excess (cycle usage read inline); credit_spend_window binds the cycle count and the measure, credit_spend_multiplier the two spend sums. Persona disclaimer no longer names swing or credit. Stale/inexact rationale wording corrected (shortfall rebill instead of 'energy-line rebill'; boundary dates 2024-10-05 and 2025-10-05). O-G2 (notice found by effective_date equal to billing_period_start; the cycle here starts 2026-01-01, so it is the notice of the calendar month containing it - the compute language has no month-of-date primitive), O-G6, O-G7, O-G9: acknowledged, no consequence on this world, no change. Gates re-run after the rework: all OK (traceability deferred).
